summary.text: David Bedey is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives, District 86, who took office on January 7, 2019, and is not seeking re-election to the House.
He is the Republican candidate for Montana State Senate District 43 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Stephen Leuchtman.

paragraphs.text: Bedey was first elected to House District 86 in 2018, defeating Democrat Jason Nickisch, and succeeded Ron Ehli.
He won re-election in 2022 over Anne Brown and in 2024 over Jeff Kempka.
Ballotpedia lists Bedey’s committee assignments in the 2025-2026 session as the Appropriations Committee and the House Rules Committee, the same two he held in 2023-2024.
He defeated Kathy Love in the June 2, 2026, Republican primary for Senate District 43.
